name: Nectarines
notes: Fresh yellow or white nectarines per lb. Exclude peaches (existing item), canned or frozen fruit, fruit cups, juice.

name: Apricots
notes: Fresh apricots per lb (seasonal). Must NOT match dried apricots, canned apricots, apricot preserves/jam (existing jelly item), apricot nectar, or baby food.

name: Pomegranate
notes: Whole fresh pomegranate sold by count. Exclude pomegranate juice (POM), aril cups, sparkling drinks, dried arils, and 'pomegranate flavored' anything.

name: Papaya
notes: Whole fresh papaya (Red/Maradol or Solo) by count; if a store prices per lb, normalize. Exclude dried papaya spears, papaya juice/nectar, fruit cups.

name: Fresh Cranberries
notes: Fresh whole cranberries in 12 oz bags (fall/holiday season). Must NOT match cranberry juice (existing item), dried cranberries/Craisins (separate candidate), canned cranberry sauce, or trail mixes.

name: Plantains
notes: Fresh green or yellow plantains sold by count. Exclude bananas (existing item), plantain chips (snack aisle), frozen sweet plantains.

name: Whole Coconut
notes: Whole fresh coconut in the produce section. Must NOT match coconut oil (existing item), coconut milk/cream/water, shredded or flaked baking coconut, coconut-flavored products.

name: Medjool Dates
notes: Whole Medjool (or pitted) dates sold in produce-section tubs/bags, normalized per oz. Exclude date syrup, date-filled bars/rolls, chopped baking dates only if brand-flavored, and fig products.

name: Dried Cranberries
notes: Sweetened dried cranberries (Craisins or store brand), plain original flavor, per oz. Exclude fresh cranberries (separate candidate), cranberry juice (existing), cranberry sauce, trail mix blends, flavored/infused varieties preferred out.

name: Prunes / Dried Plums
notes: Pitted prunes/dried plums (Sunsweet or store brand) per oz. Must NOT match fresh plums (existing item), prune juice, baby food prunes, or raisins (existing item).

name: Shallots
notes: Fresh shallots, loose per lb or small net bag normalized. Exclude green onions/scallions (existing item), regular onions, dried/fried shallot toppings.

name: Yellow / Yukon Gold Potatoes
notes: Fresh yellow/gold/Yukon Gold potatoes, loose or 5 lb bag normalized per lb. Russet and red potatoes are existing items. Exclude sweet potatoes (existing), baby/petite medley packs, instant mashed (existing), frozen potato products.

name: Mini Sweet Peppers
notes: Bagged mini sweet snacking peppers (red/yellow/orange mix), typically 1 lb, per oz. Exclude full-size bell peppers, jalapenos (existing), pickled peppers, pepper-flavored snacks.

name: Serrano Peppers
notes: Fresh serrano chile peppers per lb. Exclude jalapenos (existing item), canned/pickled serranos, hot sauce (existing item), salsa.

name: Anaheim Peppers
notes: Fresh Anaheim/long green chiles per lb (includes fresh Hatch-type in season). Must NOT match canned diced green chiles, dried chile pods, jalapenos, poblanos.

name: Habanero Peppers
notes: Fresh habanero peppers per lb (some stores price per each or small clamshell; normalize). Exclude habanero hot sauce, salsa, cheese or snacks with 'habanero' flavoring.

name: Beets (fresh)
notes: Fresh red beets, loose or bunched with greens, per lb. Must NOT match canned or pickled beets, beet juice, cooked ready-to-eat vacuum-packed beets, or sugar beet products.

name: Turnips
notes: Fresh purple-top turnip roots per lb. Exclude turnip greens (separate candidate), rutabagas (separate candidate), canned turnip greens.

name: Parsnips
notes: Fresh parsnips, loose or 1 lb bag, per lb. Exclude carrots (existing item), turnips, frozen root vegetable medleys.

name: Rutabagas
notes: Fresh waxed rutabagas per lb. Exclude turnips (separate candidate), frozen mashed root products.

name: Leeks
notes: Fresh leeks sold per stalk or bunch. Exclude green onions/scallions (existing item), dried leek soup mix, frozen soup blends.

name: Collard Greens (bunch)
notes: Fresh collard greens by the bunch (bagged chopped fresh collards acceptable if cheapest, normalized). Must NOT match canned seasoned collards (Glory), frozen collards, kale (existing item).

name: Mustard Greens (bunch)
notes: Fresh mustard greens by the bunch. CRITICAL: must NOT match yellow mustard condiment (existing 'mustard' item), Dijon/spicy brown mustard, mustard seed spice, or canned mustard greens.

name: Turnip Greens (bunch)
notes: Fresh turnip greens by the bunch. Exclude turnip roots (separate candidate), canned/frozen turnip greens, collard or mustard greens.

name: Swiss Chard (bunch)
notes: Fresh green or rainbow chard by the bunch. Exclude kale (existing), spinach (existing), spring mix blends.

name: Bok Choy
notes: Fresh bok choy or baby bok choy per lb (per-each stores normalized). Exclude napa cabbage (separate candidate), frozen stir-fry blends, prepared Asian salad kits.

name: Butternut Squash
notes: Whole fresh butternut squash per lb. Must NOT match pre-cut cubed butternut (pricier convenience SKU), frozen butternut, butternut squash soup, ravioli, or baby food.

name: Acorn Squash
notes: Whole fresh acorn squash per lb (per-each pricing normalized). Exclude butternut/spaghetti squash (separate candidates), zucchini/yellow squash (existing item), frozen squash.

name: Spaghetti Squash
notes: Whole fresh spaghetti squash per lb. CRITICAL: must NOT match spaghetti pasta (existing 'pasta' item), spaghetti sauce, canned spaghetti (SpaghettiOs), or other squash types.

name: Sugar Snap Peas
notes: Fresh sugar snap peas in 8-16 oz packs, per oz. Exclude snow peas (separate candidate), frozen peas (existing), canned peas (existing), snap pea crisps snack, split peas.

name: Spring Mix Salad Greens
notes: Bagged/clamshell spring mix or 50/50 blend, per oz. Exclude spinach-only packs (existing 'spinach' item), arugula-only (separate candidate), salad kits with dressing, iceberg garden blends (separate candidate).

name: Arugula
notes: Bagged/clamshell baby arugula, per oz. Exclude spring mix blends that merely contain arugula, spinach, salad kits.

name: Garden Salad Blend (bagged)
notes: Classic iceberg-based garden salad bag (iceberg, carrots, red cabbage), per oz. Exclude salad kits with dressing/toppings (separate candidate), spring mix, coleslaw mix, shredded lettuce only.

name: Caesar Salad Kit
notes: Complete caesar salad kit (greens + dressing + croutons), per oz. Exclude plain romaine hearts (separate candidate), bottled caesar dressing alone, crouton bags, chopped-salad kits of other flavors acceptable only if labeled caesar.

name: Coleslaw Mix
notes: Bagged shredded cabbage/carrot slaw mix (classic or tri-color), per oz. Must NOT match prepared deli coleslaw with dressing, coleslaw dressing bottles, broccoli slaw, whole cabbage.

name: Stir-Fry Vegetable Blend (fresh)
notes: Refrigerated fresh stir-fry vegetable mix (produce section), per oz. Must NOT match frozen stir-fry vegetables (existing 'frozen-vegetables' item), noodle/sauce meal kits, canned water chestnuts.

name: Fresh Bean Sprouts
notes: Fresh refrigerated mung bean sprouts, per oz. CRITICAL: must NOT match Brussels sprouts (existing item), canned bean sprouts (La Choy), alfalfa sprouts, sprouted grain bread.

name: Broccolini / Baby Broccoli
notes: Fresh broccolini/baby broccoli bunches. Must NOT match regular broccoli crowns or bunches (existing 'broccoli' item), frozen broccoli (existing), broccoli slaw. Watch substring overlap: 'broccolini' contains 'broccoli'.

name: Fennel Bulb
notes: Fresh fennel/anise bulb by count. Exclude fennel seed (spice aisle), fennel tea, sausage seasoned with fennel.

name: Chayote Squash
notes: Fresh chayote squash by count (standard at Omaha Walmart/Baker's/Family Fare). Exclude zucchini/yellow squash (existing item), winter squash candidates.

name: Yuca / Cassava Root
notes: Fresh waxed yuca (cassava) root per lb. Exclude frozen yuca, cassava flour, yuca/cassava chips, taro.

name: Jicama
notes: Fresh whole jicama root per lb. Exclude pre-cut jicama sticks with chile/lime seasoning, jicama chips.

name: Fresh Okra
notes: Fresh whole okra pods per lb. Must NOT match frozen breaded okra, frozen cut okra, pickled okra jars, canned okra & tomatoes.

name: Artichokes
notes: Fresh whole globe artichokes by count. Must NOT match canned/jarred artichoke hearts, marinated artichokes, spinach-artichoke dip, frozen artichoke hearts.

name: Fresh Rhubarb
notes: Fresh rhubarb stalks per lb (spring/summer Midwest staple). Exclude frozen rhubarb, strawberry-rhubarb pie/jam/yogurt.

name: Pie Pumpkins
notes: Small sugar/pie pumpkins by count (fall seasonal). Must NOT match large carving/jack-o-lantern pumpkins, canned pumpkin, pumpkin pie (bakery), pumpkin spice flavored products.

name: Fresh Parsley (bunch)
notes: Fresh curly or Italian flat-leaf parsley by the bunch. Must NOT match dried parsley (existing 'dried-parsley' item) or cilantro (existing item).

name: Fresh Dill
notes: Fresh dill herb pack or bunch, per oz. CRITICAL: must NOT match dill pickles (existing 'pickles' item), dill dip, dried dill weed, ranch 'with dill' products.

name: Fresh Rosemary
notes: Fresh rosemary herb pack, per oz. Exclude dried rosemary (spice aisle), rosemary crackers/bread, rosemary-scented household items.

name: Fresh Thyme
notes: Fresh thyme herb pack, per oz. Exclude dried thyme (spice aisle) and seasoning blends.
